stories.title: Enforce Canonical Provider Search Contract (No New Schema)
stories.description: Refactor provider_search_models to strictly conform to the canonical shared contract used by FIND-P-M1, ensuring input normalization (location, specialty, query) and output structure (ranked providers, scores, metadata) are consistent with downstream facade and tool_router expectations.

stories.title: Implement Vector Search with Deterministic Taxonomy Fallback
stories.description: Execute provider search using MongoDB Atlas vector search (text-embedding-3-large) with scoring and ranking, and implement deterministic fallback to NUCC taxonomy-based filtering when vector confidence thresholds are not met, including multi-stage geographic filtering.

stories.title: Integrate Provider Search into Find Care Facade Orchestration
stories.description: Wire provider_search_service into find_care_facade, orchestrating specialty identification (dual pipeline), query expansion, and location normalization before invoking search, ensuring compatibility with tool_router and conversational flow.

stories.title: Extend Provider Search Test Coverage for Ranking and Fallback Logic
stories.description: Expand existing backend tests to validate vector ranking behavior, confidence thresholds, taxonomy fallback triggers, geographic filtering stages, and edge cases without duplicating existing baseline tests.

stories.title: Validate End-to-End Integration with Embeddings and Provider Data
stories.description: Validate full integration between provider embeddings, MongoDB vector index, and search execution, ensuring alignment between DataPipelines embedding generation, stored provider records, and runtime query behavior.
